entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, what am I going to be called?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You all were using code names,[n]weren't you?
entries.uk: Ви ж усі користувалися кодовими[n]іменами, чи не так?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're quite perceptive.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This time's a hard one... Maybe somethin'[n]like "Shoulder Pads"?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why in the world did you focus on that?
entries.uk: І чого це ти зосередився саме[n]на цьому?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I refuse to be called that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What about "Rider"?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sounds too much like a smuggler. Next.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "Fixer"?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not a mastermind though. Next.
entries.uk: Але ж я не закулісний ляльковод.[n]Далі.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Won't you give me something better to[n]work with?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She reminds me of an empress.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You got anything, Joker?
entries.uk: А в тебе є ідеї, Джокере?

entries.en: Witch.
Prez.
Queen.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like it to sound a little more refined[n]than that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's totally a "Queen," isn't she?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you want to be smacked?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Guys, she's clearly a "Queen."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Whoa, I totally see it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It fits so well that I'm at a loss for words[n]here.
entries.uk: Так пасує, що мені аж слів бракує.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Queen... It has a nice ring to it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I like it. Let's go with that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now then, could you explain to me[n]the strategy for this mission?
entries.uk: А тепер чи не поясните мені[n]стратегію цієї місії?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Strategy?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...You don't have one? Wait. The Phantom[n]Thieves were acting without any plans!?
entries.uk: ...У вас її немає? Стривайте.[n]Фантомні Злодії діяли без жодних[n]планів?!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uhh... We pretty much look around the[n]area, I provide navigation when needed,[n]and then...
entries.uk: Е-е... Загалом ми оглядаємо[n]місцевість, я за потреби прокладаю[n]шлях, а тоді...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we run into Shadows, we beat the shit[n]outta 'em!
entries.uk: А як натрапимо на Тіней — лупимо[n]їх на всі заставки!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Very well then. I feel like I'll be useful[n]for sure.
entries.uk: Що ж, гаразд. Відчуваю, що точно[n]стану в пригоді.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems my role is to be the brain of this[n]team. I'll analyze Mona's information[n]and give out orders.
entries.uk: Схоже, моя роль — бути мозком[n]команди. Я аналізуватиму відомості[n]від Мони й віддаватиму накази.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Any objections?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: N-None, Queen!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I bet Skull's definitely the type that'll be[n]under a girl's thumb.
entries.uk: Б'юся об заклад, Череп із тих,[n]хто точно буде в дівчини під[n]каблуком.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mona, will you begin navigating us?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Y-Yes, Queen!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Him too, it seems...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell is this?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems as though they didn't want to leave[n]that gaping hole...
entries.uk: Схоже, вони не захотіли лишати[n]ту дірку зяяти...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But... we can't get in now...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry... I... think I might have taken it[n]a little too far...
No, you saved us.
Maybe a bit.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right. We would have been in serious[n]danger had it not been for Queen's actions.
entries.uk: Саме так. Якби не вчинок Королеви,[n]ми були б у серйозній небезпеці.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, it's not a big deal. Plus it was[n]super cool, Queen!
entries.uk: Та годі, це дрібниці. До того ж[n]це було страх як круто, Королево!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Th-Thanks...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The details are no longer important. Let us[n]search for a new infiltration point, Joker.
entries.uk: Подробиці вже неважливі. Шукаймо[n]нове місце для проникнення,[n]Джокере.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We ain't gonna be able to get through[n]like this. Let's try and find a different[n]way in.
entries.uk: Отак нам не пройти. Спробуймо[n]знайти інший вхід.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nope, no way this'll work...
